summary: Robert Evans, Katy Stoll and Cody Johnston continue reading Ben Shapiro's 2016 novel True Allegiance, mocking its prose and its plot of a CIA rescue in Tehran, a bridge bombing in New York and a Texas governor keeping troops on the border.

evidence.note: fictional White House debate over striking Tehran and its effect on nuclear talks with Iran
CIA team raids the building in Tehran where the general is held
hero stabs a teenage guard; later an operative burns in an explosion, read aloud
terrorists blow up the George Washington Bridge in the novel
Texas governor keeps Guard troops on the border; hosts call the invasion framing white supremacist

notes: Part of the multi-episode reading of True Allegiance; matches sibling records. Time is the novel's 2016 publication and unspecified near-present setting (approximate). Iran setting is fictional. propaganda-media chosen as closest primary theme; no theme fits right-wing polemical fiction exactly. Character name spellings are approximate from the transcript.
